Title: Retargetting effects during change of control? Anima Gathering vs. From a Sinking Ship

Messages.Author: d
Messages.Body:
Zoe has Anima Gathering targetting Samantha.

The unfortunate prey of this combo plays From a Sinking Ship and takes
control of Zoe (permanently).

Since Anima Gathering has now come under the control of a new
Methusaleh (by the minion card rule) can or must the new Controller
retarget the effect of Anima Gathering to one of their own minions?

If not, does Anima Gathering stop giving bonuses to Samantha because
she is not "another minion you control" ?

Name: Anima Gathering
[KMW:C]
Cardtype: Action
Discipline: Auspex
+1 stealth action.
[aus] Put this card on this acting vampire and choose another minion
you control. Burn this card if this minion untaps. During your untap
phase, you may choose not to untap this minion as normal. The chosen
minion gets +2 intercept.
[AUS] As above, and the chosen minion also gets +1 bleed.

Messages.Author: jnew...@difsol.com
Messages.Body:

> Zoe has Anima Gathering targetting Samantha.
>

>
> Since Anima Gathering has now come under the control of a new
> Methusaleh (by the minion card rule) can or must the new Controller

No, you choose the minion when you play the card.

> If not, does Anima Gathering stop giving bonuses to Samantha because
> she is not "another minion you control" ?

No. The minion must be one you control when you play Anima Gathering.
>From that point on, it is "the chosen minion" and gets the benefits
regardless of its controller.
